name: gauntlet
description: Challenge and choose with fresh subagents. run: a chain of challengers, each asking "is there a better way to do this?" and keeping or improving a proposal. vote: independent proposers and blind voters pick among discrete options, with plurality, Borda and Condorcet tallies. auto: a selector routes the request to vote, gauntlet, either composed with the other, or none, and runs it.
